project_opwin_session_bug_rootcause.text: opwin.io dashboards broken (Nov 22 2026): root cause proven — server/index.ts sets cookie.secure=true in production but never calls app.set('trust proxy',1), and nginx location / sends no X-Forwarded-Proto. express-session 1.19.0 index.js:242 silently skips Set-Cookie when secure && !issecure(req), so login returns 200 with no cookie; /api/owner/overview then 403 and /api/me/requests 401. Fix needs BOTH: app.set('trust proxy',1) in Express AND proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme (+X-Forwarded-For) in nginx. Not a popup blocker.
